PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Middle Office / Investment Operations professional with 3+ years supporting the full equity trade lifecycle — trade settlement, 
corporate actions, cash and position reconciliation, and exception/incident resolution — across broking and securities firms. Proven 
track record driving root cause analysis and control improvements while coordinating across trading, compliance, and 
depository/custodian teams to resolve time-sensitive breaks and settlement issues. Consistently maintained 99% accuracy across 
settlement and reconciliation processes handling high-volume, time-sensitive data. CIBOP and NISM-certified across securities 
operations, equity derivatives, and mutual fund distribution, with hands-on exposure to listed and OTC products.

Senior Executive – Operations Aug 2026 – Present 
Way2Wealth Brokers Private Limited, Mumbai 
• Act as a key point of contact for margin pledge, unpledge, and repledge exceptions, coordinating with clearing corporations and 
internal stakeholders to keep collateral positions accurate and audit-ready. 
• Own resolution of unpaid MTF (Margin Trading Facility) exceptions, tracking funded positions end-to-end and driving timely 
recovery actions to prevent downstream settlement risk. 
• Investigate and resolve inward shortage and SLB (Securities Lending & Borrowing) early pay-in cases, partnering with 
depositories and counterparties to close breaks within tight settlement timelines. 
• Manage CUSPA pay-in/pay-out and daily pay-in checks, proactively flagging exceptions ahead of settlement cut-offs to minimize 
fails and maintain control integrity. 
• Coordinate mutual fund unit invocation-cum-redemption processing across teams, ensuring accurate, compliant execution and 
clear communication with stakeholders on status and exceptions.

Yes Securities Limited, Mumbai

• Reconciled equity positions daily against NSDL/CDSL depository records and custodians, investigating short deliveries, auction 
cases, and settlement mismatches to root cause and closure. 
• Reviewed trade confirmations to flag potential settlement failures early, coordinating across internal teams and external 
counterparties to resolve issues before they escalated. 
• Tracked corporate action events — dividends, mergers, stock splits — end-to-end, ensuring timely and accurate capture in client 
accounts to avoid downstream valuation or entitlement breaks. 
• Maintained 99% accuracy across settlement and reconciliation processes; built Excel-based tracking (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, 
XLOOKUP) to monitor exception volumes and turnaround times. 
Assistant Manager – Operations Dec 2022 – Jul 2024 
Kotak Securities Limited, Mumbai

settlement within exchange-mandated timelines. 
• Handled DP-level operations including securities pay-in/pay-out, margin pledge/unpledge, and resolution of settlement 
shortages and auction obligations, serving as first point of escalation for exceptions. 
• Coordinated with internal departments and external counterparties to research and resolve operational issues with urgency, 
escalating to team leaders and contributing to post-issue process fixes. 
• Reduced reporting errors through rigorous data validation, quality checks, and process-driven controls, sustaining 99% accuracy 
across client portfolios.
